brief: 5 skincare myths a board-certified specialist wants you to stop believing.

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.subtitle: SEPARATING FACT FROM FICTION IN SKINCARE

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.title: NATURAL IS ALWAYS BETTER
slots.body: Poison ivy is natural, yet highly irritating. Lab-synthesized ingredients like hyaluronic acid are often safer, more stable, and better for your skin barrier. Efficacy depends on science, not source.

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.title: SKIP MOISTURIZER IF OILY
slots.body: Dehydrated oily skin overcompensates by producing more sebum. A lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturizer balances oil production and strengthens your barrier without causing breakouts.

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.title: TINGLING MEANS IT WORKS
slots.body: That stinging sensation is usually inflammation, not progress. Chronic irritation weakens the skin barrier and can lead to sensitivity, redness, and premature aging over time.

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.title: PORES OPEN AND CLOSE
slots.body: Pores are not doors with tiny muscles. Their appearance changes with oil, debris, and age, but they cannot physically open or close with steam or cold water.

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.title: SUNSCREEN IS ONLY OUTDOORS
slots.body: UVA rays penetrate windows and cause premature aging year-round. Daily broad-spectrum protection is essential whether you are commuting, sitting indoors, or facing cloudy skies.

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.title: SCRUB HARDER FOR RESULTS
slots.body: Aggressive exfoliation strips the protective barrier and triggers inflammation. Gentle chemical exfoliants used two to three times weekly reveal smoother skin without causing damage.

slots.author: SARAH CHEN
slots.headline: READY FOR RADIANCE
slots.body: Stop guessing and start treating your skin with the precision it deserves. Book your personalized consultation today.
